sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use korán for early and későn for late.

korán and későn both end in that same -n you've seen on time-of-day words — Hungarian likes marking "in a X manner" with a nasal ending across a whole family of adverbs. You don't need the grammar term for it yet; just notice the shape keeps recurring, so the next one you meet will already look familiar.
